notes:
Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — The P0 dead variant issue means callers of pkix-chain-simple cannot reliably distinguish critical vs non-critical extension rejections. The P1 missing re-exports mean pkix-chain is less useful as an umbrella crate. Core path validation logic is sound.
Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Least confident flags: ValidatedPath::depth semantics when trust anchor cert appears in chain (edge case, documented behavior may be surprising). Uncertainty driven by: not running the PKITS 4.3/4.6/4.7 test files, not checking all test fixtures. Would raise confidence if: ran full test suite and verified all PKITS sections pass.
Idiom rating: ACCEPTABLE — Core path validation code is idiomatic. Main issues: reason_code as u8 instead of CrlReason enum (type safety), ValidatedPath missing derives, check_critical_extensions returning bool. No unsafe code. No unwrap in production paths. Error types are well-structured with #[non_exhaustive].
Rust idiom confidence: 10% chance of missed issue. Least confident flags: didn't check all lifetime elision opportunities in trait impls. Uncertainty driven by: didn't check generated code from derive macros or cfg combinations.
